IVX HOLDINGS — 100-MODULE INSTAGRAM-LEVEL MEDIA QA, DEVELOPMENT, DEPLOYMENT, AND LIVE VERIFICATION

OWNER APPROVAL: EXECUTE NOW

OBJECTIVE

Audit, repair, develop, test, deploy, and verify 100 IVX modules across the complete Expo React Native Android/iOS/Web application and public landing page.

The complete media experience must use mature Instagram-style techniques for:

- video
- pictures
- posts
- reels
- carousels
- uploads
- downloads
- saving
- sharing
- playback
- caching
- background processing
- recovery
- engagement

Do not create a second application.
Do not rebuild IVX as a separate Kotlin application.
Continue using the existing IVX Expo React Native codebase.

This is an execution task, not a planning task.

============================================================
GLOBAL RULES
============================================================

1. Audit MODULE-001 through MODULE-100.
2. Every module must have one result:
   - PASS
   - FAIL
   - BLOCKED
   - NOT APPLICABLE
3. Do not stop after identifying problems.
4. Repair every issue that can be completed with current access.
5. Run regression tests after every repair.
6. Deploy only through TEAM-12 Release Manager.
7. Production deployment requires owner approval.
8. No PASS without live evidence.
9. Do not use fake data, simulated uploads, or placeholder success.
10. Every media URL must come from the real production database/storage.
11. Preserve existing members, investors, buyers, properties, deals, reels, posts, messages, documents, and transactions.
12. Back up the database, storage metadata, and repository before changes.

============================================================
REQUIRED EVIDENCE FOR EVERY MODULE
============================================================

Return:

- Module number
- Module name
- Task ID
- Start timestamp
- End timestamp
- Platform tested
- Device/browser tested
- Expected result
- Actual result
- PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / N/A
- Root cause
- Files inspected
- Files changed
- Test commands
- Test results
- Screenshot or video evidence
- API response/status
- Database evidence
- Storage evidence
- Defect ID
- Retest result
- Proof Ledger ID

For code changes also provide:

- GitHub repository
- Branch
- Commit SHA
- Pull request, if used

For deployments also provide:

- Render Service ID
- Render Deployment ID
- Deployment final state
- Runtime SHA
- Health results
- Rollback reference

============================================================
MODULES 001–010 — CORE MEDIA ARCHITECTURE
============================================================

MODULE-001  Production media architecture map
MODULE-002  Expo media dependencies audit
MODULE-003  Supabase Storage integration
MODULE-004  Media database schema
MODULE-005  Media ownership and RLS
MODULE-006  Signed/public URL strategy
MODULE-007  Image transformation pipeline
MODULE-008  Video processing pipeline
MODULE-009  Thumbnail generation
MODULE-010  Media deletion and cleanup

Verify:

- no broken references
- no duplicate storage objects
- no unauthorized access
- no expired URL failures
- no orphaned database records
- no orphaned storage files

============================================================
MODULES 011–020 — IMAGE UPLOAD EXPERIENCE
============================================================

MODULE-011  Camera image capture
MODULE-012  Gallery image selection
MODULE-013  Multiple-image selection
MODULE-014  Image preview
MODULE-015  Image reorder
MODULE-016  Image crop
MODULE-017  Image rotation
MODULE-018  Image compression
MODULE-019  Image upload progress
MODULE-020  Image upload retry

Requirements:

- support up to 20 pictures per post/message where authorized
- preserve orientation
- prevent duplicate upload
- show real progress
- resume recoverable uploads
- provide cancel and retry
- never lose selected images after temporary failure

============================================================
MODULES 021–030 — VIDEO UPLOAD EXPERIENCE
============================================================

MODULE-021  Camera video recording
MODULE-022  Gallery video selection
MODULE-023  Video preview
MODULE-024  Video trimming readiness
MODULE-025  Video compression
MODULE-026  Video upload progress
MODULE-027  Background upload
MODULE-028  Interrupted upload recovery
MODULE-029  Video thumbnail
MODULE-030  Video metadata persistence

Requirements:

- support up to 5 videos where authorized
- validate file type and file size
- preserve duration, width, height, and orientation
- never freeze the mobile UI
- upload through background-safe jobs
- resume after app background/foreground
- prevent duplicate database rows

============================================================
MODULES 031–040 — INSTAGRAM-STYLE REELS
============================================================

MODULE-031  Vertical reels feed
MODULE-032  One active video at a time
MODULE-033  Auto-play visible reel
MODULE-034  Pause hidden reel
MODULE-035  Swipe next/previous
MODULE-036  Loop playback
MODULE-037  Mute/unmute
MODULE-038  Playback progress
MODULE-039  Reel preload
MODULE-040  Reel playback recovery

Acceptance criteria:

- smooth vertical scrolling
- no jumping page
- no multiple videos playing simultaneously
- no black frame during normal preload
- no audio overlap
- no memory leak after repeated swipes
- failed video can retry without leaving the feed
- reel position remains stable after like/comment/share

============================================================
MODULES 041–050 — POSTS AND CAROUSELS
============================================================

MODULE-041  Single-image post
MODULE-042  Multi-image carousel
MODULE-043  Video post
MODULE-044  Mixed image/video post
MODULE-045  Carousel swipe
MODULE-046  Carousel page indicators
MODULE-047  Post caption
MODULE-048  Post location
MODULE-049  Post author/profile
MODULE-050  Post timestamp and editing

Verify:

- correct media belongs to the correct property/deal
- no Casa Rosario/Perez Residence media mixing
- no repeated cards
- no missing media after refresh
- carousel does not jump
- correct image count displayed
- media order persists after restart

============================================================
MODULES 051–060 — DOWNLOAD, SAVE, AND SHARE
============================================================

MODULE-051  Download image to device
MODULE-052  Download video to device
MODULE-053  Download document
MODULE-054  Download permission handling
MODULE-055  Download progress
MODULE-056  Download retry
MODULE-057  Save post inside IVX
MODULE-058  Save reel inside IVX
MODULE-059  Native share sheet
MODULE-060  Copy secure share link

Requirements:

- owner-controlled download permissions
- respect content ownership and privacy
- no download of restricted/private content without authorization
- correct filename and file extension
- downloaded file opens successfully
- no corrupted partial file
- Android storage permission handled correctly
- iOS Photos permission readiness
- web browser download works
- share link opens the correct content
- revoked/private content must stop resolving

============================================================
MODULES 061–070 — SOCIAL ENGAGEMENT
============================================================

MODULE-061  Like post
MODULE-062  Unlike post
MODULE-063  Like reel
MODULE-064  Comments
MODULE-065  Comment delete/edit permissions
MODULE-066  Share count
MODULE-067  Save count
MODULE-068  View count
MODULE-069  Follow/connection readiness
MODULE-070  Engagement notifications

Verify:

- optimistic UI rolls back on failure
- no duplicate likes
- counts remain correct after refresh
- unauthorized users cannot edit/delete another user’s content
- comments remain ordered and persistent
- realtime updates do not create duplicates

============================================================
MODULES 071–080 — LANDING PAGE MEDIA
============================================================

MODULE-071  Landing hero media
MODULE-072  Investment-card images
MODULE-073  Investment-card video
MODULE-074  Landing reels section
MODULE-075  Three-deals/one-video ordering
MODULE-076  Mobile landing-page slider
MODULE-077  Desktop landing-page slider
MODULE-078  Landing-page media preload
MODULE-079  Landing media analytics
MODULE-080  Landing registration-to-member synchronization

Verify:

- no jumping page
- no white top banner
- no disappearing reels
- no incorrect property media
- no layout shift while images load
- images use responsive sizes
- video does not block page loading
- landing registration reaches Supabase and Members
- all public content is real production content

============================================================
MODULES 081–090 — CHAT AND DOCUMENT MEDIA
============================================================

MODULE-081  Image attachment in chat
MODULE-082  Video attachment in chat
MODULE-083  PDF/document attachment
MODULE-084  Attachment preview
MODULE-085  Upload progress in chat
MODULE-086  Attachment persistence
MODULE-087  Attachment download
MODULE-088  Message ordering
MODULE-089  Duplicate-message prevention
MODULE-090  Chat restart/recovery

Requirements:

- message IDs remain stable
- attachment remains accessible after app restart
- upload failure does not erase the draft
- keyboard does not cover composer
- scroll-to-last works
- message does not disappear
- send/read-back verified
- no duplicate message from retry

============================================================
MODULES 091–100 — ENTERPRISE QA, PERFORMANCE, AND RELEASE
============================================================

MODULE-091  Media caching
MODULE-092  Cache invalidation
MODULE-093  Memory pressure handling
MODULE-094  Bandwidth optimization
MODULE-095  Slow-network performance
MODULE-096  Offline/degraded behavior
MODULE-097  Security and content access
MODULE-098  Full Android regression
MODULE-099  Full web/landing regression
MODULE-100  iOS readiness and final release certification

============================================================
INSTAGRAM-STYLE ENGINEERING TECHNIQUES REQUIRED
============================================================

Implement or verify:

1. Virtualized feeds.
2. Viewability-based video playback.
3. One active reel player.
4. Preload only nearby content.
5. Paginated API requests.
6. Cursor-based pagination where appropriate.
7. Thumbnail-first loading.
8. Progressive image rendering.
9. Optimized image sizes per device.
10. CDN/cache headers.
11. Signed URL refresh.
12. Background uploads.
13. Chunked/resumable upload where supported.
14. Upload idempotency.
15. Local draft persistence.
16. Optimistic engagement updates.
17. Automatic rollback after failed mutation.
18. Durable media jobs.
19. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter.
20. Circuit breaker for storage/provider failures.
21. Playback-state persistence.
22. Duplicate request prevention.
23. Memory cleanup for off-screen media.
24. Network-aware media quality.
25. Real-time engagement synchronization.
26. Native download manager integration.
27. Android MediaStore handling.
28. iOS Photos/Files readiness.
29. Web Blob download handling.
30. Centralized media error reporting.

============================================================
MEDIA DOWNLOAD SECURITY RULES
============================================================

Downloads must follow access policy:

PUBLIC CONTENT
- authorized direct or signed download
- analytics event recorded

MEMBER CONTENT
- authenticated access required

PRIVATE DEAL CONTENT
- deal/member/owner authorization required

OWNER-ONLY CONTENT
- owner role required

KYC, FINANCIAL, AND LEGAL DOCUMENTS
- never publicly downloadable
- signed temporary URLs only
- access event logged
- no URL exposed permanently

============================================================
FULL END-TO-END QA MATRIX
============================================================

Test on:

ANDROID
- current production APK
- camera
- gallery
- downloads
- storage permissions
- background/foreground
- weak network
- app restart

WEB
- Chrome mobile
- Chrome desktop
- landing page
- image/video upload
- downloads
- share links

IOS READINESS
- Photos permissions
- Files permissions
- camera permissions
- background upload configuration
- video playback configuration
- TestFlight build readiness

Test network conditions:

- Wi-Fi
- 5G
- slow connection
- temporary offline
- interrupted upload
- interrupted download
- provider timeout
- storage timeout

============================================================
PERFORMANCE ACCEPTANCE
============================================================

Measure and report:

- landing-page initial load
- feed first-content render
- reel start time
- image decode time
- video buffer time
- upload speed
- download speed
- memory usage after 50 reel swipes
- CPU usage
- bandwidth usage
- failed-request rate
- duplicate-request rate

Do not claim Instagram-level performance without measured results.

============================================================
AUTONOMOUS DEFECT REPAIR LOOP
============================================================

For every failure:

1. Create defect ID.
2. Reproduce the issue.
3. Capture trace ID and logs.
4. Identify root cause.
5. Assign correct IVX engineering team.
6. Apply smallest safe fix.
7. Run typecheck.
8. Run unit tests.
9. Run integration tests.
10. Run affected E2E tests.
11. Run full media regression.
12. Build.
13. Request owner deployment approval.
14. Deploy through TEAM-12 only.
15. Verify production.
16. Retest original defect.
17. Add Proof Ledger entry.
18. Continue to the next module.

Do not wait for another owner message unless an approval gate is required.

Begin MODULE-001 now and continue through MODULE-100.
